There are currently 2 seats free in the CS3E1 Machine Learning elective [SQL].

| Course Code | Title | Capacity | Enrolled Count | Free Seats |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| CS3E1 | Machine Learning | 15 | 13 | 2 |

Per university policy, each elective has a fixed capacity, and once full, additional requests are placed on a waiting list [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §5 Elective capacity and waiting lists].
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_code, c.title, c.capacity FROM courses AS c JOIN departments AS d ON c.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE c.course_code = 'CS3E1'), e AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(*) AS enrolled_cnt FROM enrollments AS e WHERE e.status = 'enrolled' AND e.term = '2026-ODD' GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_code, c.title, c.capacity, COALESCE(e.enrolled_cnt, 0) AS enrolled_count, c.capacity - COALESCE(e.enrolled_cnt, 0) AS free_seats FROM c LEFT JOIN e ON c.course_id = e.course_id LIMIT 200
